title: Optima Health v Secretary of State for Work and Pensions
description: Optima alleges that DWP excluded its bid over minor clerical errors in its pricing schedule — a small number of line items that exceeded the relevant framework ceiling prices — without first seeking clarification about the apparent errors. DWP disputes that clarification was required, maintaining that the tender documentation made clear that bids exceeding the framework ceiling would or might be excluded. Optima's bid scored highest of all tenderers on quality.
bidder_name: Working on Wellbeing Ltd (t/a Optima Health)
